name: Endruff Lotion 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About ENDRUFF 2+5 LOTION

Endruff Lotion is an antidandruff solution used to remove dandruff from the scalp and to eliminate itching, dryness and flakes. It contains cetrimide and calcium pantothenate as active ingredients that help to relieve discomfort of dandruff form the scalp.

Certimide exhibits a disinfectant and antiseptic action and helps in eliminating crusty and dry scales on the scalp. Calcium pantothenate promotes regeneration of damaged scalp skin in dermatoses of different origin involving the skin as well as mucous membrane.

Shampoo your hair properly and rinse thoroughly. Gently massage Endruff Lotion on the scalp and the hair and allow it to stay on the scalp for 10 to 30 minutes. Wash the scalp and hair with warm water thoroughly, rubbing away all the softened crust and scales. During management with Endruff Lotion, it is recommended to take a low-fat diet.

Betadine Ointment is a topical antiseptic which is used in the management of common skin conditions such as infections of the skin around nails and management of infections in minor burns, cuts and abrasions. It contains povidone-iodine as an active ingredient which is active against a wide variety of pathogens.

Povidone-iodine works by penetrating the cell wall of microorganisms by disrupting their proteins and nucleic acid structure and synthesis. Thus, it deactivates the function of microorganisms, manages infection and helps for faster healing.

Introduction About CIPLADINE OINTMENT

Cipladine Ointment is an anti-septic ointment which is used as a first aid to manage infection in minor wounds, cuts, scrapes, burns and abrasions. It can be used for pre and post operative skin disinfection, while performing wound dressings and during management of decubitus ulcers (pressure sores). It contains povidone iodine as an active ingredient to manage infection of the wound.

Povidone iodine is a broad-spectrum antiseptic which penetrates microbe and oxidizes proteins, nucleotides and fatty acids which causes death of the microbe. It is effective against wide range of infection causing microbes such as bacteria, fungi, protozoa and viruses.

Always use Cipladine Ointment as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected area before application. Apply a small amount of ointment over the affected area as directed by the doctor. It may be covered with a sterile bandage. Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membrane. Do not use Cipladine ointment if you are allergic to any of its components.

introduction:
Introduction About PURADINE OINTMENT

PURADINE OINTMENT contains Povidone-Iodine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Broad-spectrum antiseptics. PURADINE OINTMENT is used as an antiseptic for the management of minor damage or infection of the skin. It kills harmful infection-causing microorganisms.

It also helps in the management of infection in burns, lacerations, cuts, and abrasions, management of common skin infections, and infection control following circumcision, suture removal, and dressing changes, degerming care of stasis ulcers, decubitus ulcers, and the umbilical area, and in other procedures where degerming is needed.

Before using PURADINE OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you have any kind of allergies, if you currently have or have ever had a thyroid problem, if you are currently having lithium therapy for depression, if your skin is broken (for example, due to a burn), or if you currently have, or have ever had, a kidney problem.

PURADINE OINTMENT should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women and the elderly. PURADINE OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children less than 2 years of age. The common side effects of using PURADINE OINTMENT are burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

Introduction About SEBOZIT GEL

SEBOZIT GEL contains Salicylic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Keratolytic agents. SEBOZIT GEL is used manage skin conditions such as acne, blemishes (discolored spot-on skin), skin redness, and other skin diseases.

It is also used to manage dandruff, corn & calluses (thickened layers of skin) in affected individuals.

SEBOZIT GEL is not recommended for use in patients allergic to salicylic acid. It is also not recommended for use in patients with active inflammation/dermatitis, infection (at the application site), acute viral infection, skin malignancy, and/or tanned skin.

Before applying SEBOZIT GEL, inform your doctor if you are scheduled for surgery, and/or suffering from any kidney problems.

SEBOZIT GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. It is considered to be safe to be used in breastfeeding women. Avoid applying the medicine on skin areas which might come in direct contact with infant’s skin.

SEBOZIT GEL should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 1-15 years). It is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before applying the medicine.

The most common side effects of applying SEBOZIT GEL are erythema (skin redness), and/or dryness of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

NEOSPORIN ANTIBIOTIC OINTMENT is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. NEOSPORIN ANTIBIOTIC OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. How NEOSPORIN ANTIBIOTIC OINTMENT Works

NEOSPORIN ANTIBIOTIC OINTMENT works by managing bacterial growth. The three components present in NEOSPORIN ANTIBIOTIC OINTMENT actively work by managing the bacterial growth by blocking the enzymes and substances required for its growth. Bacitracin breaks the peptidoglycan chain needed for cell growth. Neomycin binds with proteins required for cell growth, which leads to the production of defective cell membranes. Polymyxin B damages the bacterial cell membrane, which causes leakage of cell components.

Introduction About ELOSONE HT CREAM

It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with ELOSONE HT CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using ELOSONE HT CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Introduction About VALBET SKIN CREAM

VALBET SKIN CREAM is a combination of Beclomethasone dipropionate, Miconazole and Neomycin which belongs to a group of medicines called Corticosteroids, Antifungals and Aminoglycoside antibiotics, respectively. VALBET SKIN CREAM is used to manage, control, manage & improve the conditions and symptoms of runny nose, hay fever/allergic rhinitis (type of nose inflammation), ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), asthma, hepatic coma (nervous system disorder that occurs due to severe liver disease), wound, ulcers, external ear infections, eye infections, diarrhea, napkin rash, paronychia (nail inflammation), bacterial infections and fungal infections such as vulvovaginal candidiasis and vaginal yeast infections. 

A bacterial infection occurs when a bacterium enters the body and causes a reaction that leads to infection, which is characterised by symptoms such as difficulty breathing, persistent cough and fever. A fungal infection is a skin disease caused by a fungus that lives on plants, dirt and household surfaces and, upon contact, leads to skin diseases generally characterised by symptoms such as irritation, scaly skin, itching and swelling in the affected individuals.

VALBET SKIN CREAM is not recommended for use in patients with skin problems such as acne (pimples), rosacea (severe flushing of the skin), perioral dermatitis (spotty red rash around your mouth), viral infections, fungal infections and skin blisters or sores that are caused by an infection.

Before applying VALBET SKIN CREAM, inform your doctor if you have cystic fibrosis (a genetic disorder that damages the lungs, digestive tract and other organs), psoriasis (itchy skin), abdominal pain, chills or fever. VALBET SKIN CREAM should be used with caution during pregnancy and only when necessary in breastfeeding women.

It is not recommended for use in children (below 1 year) and should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 2 to 18 years) after consulting the doctor. The most common symptoms of applying VALBET SKIN CREAM are an itchy rash, burning or stinging sensations and/or itchiness at the site of the application. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About DIAPERSAFE CREAM

Diapersafe Cream is a non-irritating and non-staining diaper rash cream used for managing and managing rashes, redness, and inflammation due to diaper use and tight clothing in babies. It manages contact irritant dermatitis and perianal skin rashes due to diarrhea and soothes the baby’s sensitive skin. It can also manage bacterial and yeast infections and allergies associated with diaper material. Diapersafe Cream contains Aloe vera extract, Zinc oxide, Vitamin A, Vitamin E, Niacinamide, D-panthenol and Magnesium sulphate as active ingredients that are gentle on baby's sensitive skin.

Aloe vera helps to manage skin infections, irritations, and inflammation. It soothes, heals and moisturizes the skin. Zinc oxide has anti-inflammatory, anti-irritant, regenerative, and moisturizing properties. It also acts as a strong antioxidant and antibacterial agent. D-panthenol acts as a humectant that manages moisture loss from the skin and maintains a healthy natural skin barrier.

Diapersafe Cream is for external use only. Change the wet and spoiled diapers and clean the diaper area with warm water. Dry the diaper area completely and apply the cream gently on the affected area as often as required or after changing the diaper (especially during the night). Consult your doctor in case of irritation persists.

Diapersafe Cream is safe and unlikely to cause any side effects. Consult your doctor if your child experiences any side effects or an allergic reaction after using this cream.

introduction:
Introduction About WOKADINE OINTMENT

WOKADINE OINTMENT contains Povidone-Iodine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Broad-spectrum antiseptics. WOKADINE OINTMENT is used as an antiseptic for the management of minor damage or infection of the skin. It kills harmful infection-causing microorganisms.

It also helps in the management of infection in burns, lacerations, cuts, and abrasions, management of common skin infections, and infection control following circumcision, suture removal, and dressing changes, degerming care of stasis ulcers, decubitus ulcers, and the umbilical area, and in other procedures where degerming is needed.

Before using WOKADINE OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you have any kind of allergies, if you currently have or have ever had a thyroid problem, if you are currently having lithium therapy for depression, if your skin is broken (for example, due to a burn), or if you currently have, or have ever had, a kidney problem.

WOKADINE OINTMENT should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women and the elderly. WOKADINE OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children less than 2 years of age. The common side effects of using WOKADINE OINTMENT are burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About SILVOWEL GEL

SILVOWEL GEL contains Nanocrystalline Silver, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used in the management of burns and wound infections. It is also used for the management of surgical cuts, leg ulcers, pressure sores, abrasions, blisters, cracked skin, minor skin cuts, and for prophylaxis of infection at the skin graft donor site.

Do not use it if you are allergic to nanocrystalline silver or any other ingredients of this medicine. There are no adequate studies on the use of SILVOWEL GEL in pregnant women. It should be used only if clearly needed and justified by the doctor.

SILVOWEL GEL should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it is not known whether this medicine passes into the human breast milk. Consult your doctor before using it. The safety and effectiveness of SILVOWEL GEL have not been established in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using SILVOWEL GEL are skin necrosis, erythema multiforme, burning sensation, rashes, and interstitial nephritis. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Povi-10 Solution is a microbicidal solution used as an adjunctive management of infection in skin loss lesion-cuts, ulcers and wounds including post-operative wounds. It contains povidone iodine as an active ingredient to decrease the risk of infection by killing the micro-organisms at the site of application.

Povidone-iodine inhibits the synthesis of various cellular mechanisms of bacteria that lead to their death. Also, it exhibits anti-inflammatory reactions that counteracts inflammation associated with pathogens and host response.

Always use Povi-10 Solution as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Clean the affected area and apply a small amount of solution to the affected area. The area may be left uncovered or you may cover with a sterile bandage.

Sepovin Ointment is a microbicidal ointment used for cuts and wounds. It contains Povidone iodine as an active ingredient. It is used in the management of tears, abrasions and minor burns. It manages and manages skin infections caused by cuts and wounds.

Povidone iodine is an antiseptic and disinfectant agent works against the harmful microbes and managing the growth of the infection from spreading in the regions of cuts and wounds.

Use Sepovin Ointment as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Read the label for directions before use. Wash your hands before and after the application of the ointment. name: Metacortil Lite Cream 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About METACORTIL LITE CREAM

METACORTIL LITE CREAM is a combination of Hydroquinone, Tretinoin, Mometasone furoate which belongs to the group of medicines called Depigmenting agents, Retinoids and Corticosteroids respectively. It is used in adults for the management of moderate to severe melasma (dark spots on the skin) in association with sun-avoidance measures, like using sunscreens and wearing protective clothing. Melasma is one of the most frequently acquired hyperpigmentation (excess melanin production) disorders with symptoms such as symmetrical brown patches on sun exposed areas mainly on face.

It is advised to avoid exposure to sun during management with METACORTIL LITE CREAM for better results. While going out apply sunscreens and wear full covering protective clothes. Before using METACORTIL LITE CREAM inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases.

Safety and efficacy of METACORTIL LITE CREAM is not established in pregnant women and in children below 12 years of age. Ask for your doctor’s advice before using. METACORTIL LITE CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of using METACORTIL LITE CREAM are mild burning, stinging, redness and dryness. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

How METACORTIL LITE CREAM Works

Thus, it helps for fading of dark spots in skin. Tretinoin helps to recover the damage to the skin caused by sun exposure (photodamage) by thickening skin layer and loss of keratinized cells.it helps to rejuvenate the skin. Mometasone furoate blocks prostaglandin synthesis and reduces redness, swelling and itching caused by tretinoin and other skin infections.

Apply METACORTIL LITE CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after applying METACORTIL LITE CREAM. introduction:
Introduction About SUCRALIME ANO CREAM

SUCRALIME ANO CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine, Metronidazole and Sucralfate which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetics, Nitroimidazoles amd Cytoprotective agents. It is used in the management of bedsores (injuries that happen on areas of the skin under pressure for a prolonged time), haemorrhoids (swollen and inflamed veins in the anus that cause discomfort, bleeding and itching) and fistulae (infected tunnel between the skin and the anus).

It also helps to manage pain, swelling and discharge of blood or pus from the anus, known as anal fissures (a small cut or tear in the delicate lining of the anus that occurs when passing hard or large stools, causing pain and bleeding during bowel movements along with increased frequency).

While using SUCRALIME ANO CREAM, avoid contact with the eyes. If contact occurs, immediately wash it out with water or saline. Before using SUCRALIME ANO CREAM, inform your doctor if you have irritated skin. SUCRALIME ANO CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children, adolescents (below 18 years of age) and elderly patients.

The common side effects of SUCRALIME ANO CREAM are dry skin, redness, itching, skin rash, pain, a burning sensation and the appearance of red, itchy welts on the skin surface. If any of these symptoms become worse, contact your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About SILVA CREAM

SILVA CREAM is used as a topical anti-infective for dermal injuries. It has a wide antibacterial spectrum including virtually all microbial species likely to infect the burn wound. It contains Chlorhexidine, Lignocaine and Silver Sulphadiazine which belongs to group of medicines known as Antimicrobials, Local anesthetics and Sulfa antibiotics respectively. SILVA CREAM works by inhibiting the growth and multiplication of bacterial cells without affecting the cells of the skin and subcutaneous tissue.

Silver Sulfadiazine is a sulfa derivative topical antibacterial used primarily as a topical burn cream on second and third-degree burns. Chlorhexidine Gluconate is a chemical antiseptic. It works against both gram-positive and gram-negative microbes. It is also bacteriostatic. Before using the medicine, inform your doctor if you have any allergic or hypersensitive reactions. SILVA CREAM is not recommended for use in pregnancy, lactation women and neonates.

The most common side effects of using SILVA CREAM are itching, burning sensation and rash. Consult with your doctor if any of these side effects worsen or does not improve.

It reduces the growth of a wide array of bacteria, as well as yeast, on the damaged skin.

introduction:
Introduction About MEGANANO GEL

MEGANANO GEL contains Nanocrystalline Silver, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used in the management of burns and wound infections. It is also used for the management of surgical cuts, leg ulcers, pressure sores, abrasions, blisters, cracked skin, minor skin cuts, and for prophylaxis of infection at the skin graft donor site.

Do not use it if you are allergic to nanocrystalline silver or any other ingredients of this medicine. There are no adequate studies on the use of MEGANANO GEL in pregnant women. It should be used only if clearly needed and justified by the doctor.

MEGANANO GEL should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it is not known whether this medicine passes into the human breast milk. Consult your doctor before using it. The safety and effectiveness of MEGANANO GEL have not been established in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using MEGANANO GEL are skin necrosis, erythema multiforme, burning sensation, rashes, and interstitial nephritis. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About NEXOSCAB LOTION

NEXOSCAB LOTION contains Cetrimide and Gamma benzene hexachloride, which belong to the group of medicines called Antiseptics and Antiparasitic drugs, respectively. It is used for the management of scabies (skin infection with itchy skin rashes caused by mites), pediculosis (infestation of scalp caused by eggs, larvae, or adults of lice), and lice.

It is advised to avoid person-to-person contact and sharing of clothes and utensils with infected persons to avoid the risk of spreading of scabies and lice. It is not recommended to use NEXOSCAB LOTION if you have fits, allergies to any of its ingredients, open, broken, or cranky skin. Before using NEXOSCAB LOTION, inform your doctor if you have HIV or AIDS, have a history of fits or conditions like a head injury, tumour in your brain or spinal cord, cirrhosis of the liver, or are heavy alcohol drinkers.

NEXOSCAB LOTION is not recommended to be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless it is clearly necessary. Do not use NEXOSCAB LOTION to manage a premature infant, young baby, or elderly patient. The most common side effects of using NEXOSCAB LOTION include tingling, itching, burning in the skin, and skin rashes. Consult a doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

TIGOTREAT CREAM contains Ozenoxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage topical impetigo in adults and children aged 2 months and above.

Impetigo is a superficial skin infection mainly affects the infants and children. Symptoms include red sores on the face, nose, mouth or on the arms and legs.

Before applying TIGOTREAT CREAM, inform your doctor if you have bacterial or fungal infections, contact dermatitis. Consult your doctor for advice.

There is no information on the use of the TIGOTREAT CREAM in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before applying. TIGOTREAT CREAM should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before applying.

TIGOTREAT CREAM should be used with caution in children aged 2 months to 17 years of age. Contact your doctor before applying.

TIGOTREAT CREAM should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Contact your doctor before applying.

The most common side effects of this medicine are irritation and itching at the application site, rosacea and seborrheic dermatitis. Contact your physician if the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CETRILAK BABY SOAP

Cetrilak Baby Soap is a skin care soap which is used to make your baby’s skin soft, supple, well hydrated and improve the skin tone. It contains azadirachta indica oil, tulsi oil, amla extract and rosemary extract as active ingredients that help moisturize and nourish the skin.

Azadirachta indica oil is rich in antioxidants and helps to boost immune response in tissues of affected skin area. Tulsi oil makes the dull skin shiny and leaves the skin toned, protected, and smoother.

Amla extract contains vitamin C that absorbs well into skin and has good moisturizing and water-retaining properties. Rosemary oil is effective in skin hydration.

Apply Cetrilak Baby Soap on your baby’s skin and produce lather by rubbing in a circular motion. Wash off and pat dry with a clean towel. It is for external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Consult your doctor if your baby experiences any unusual side effects while using Cetrilak Baby Soap.

introduction:
Introduction About SALIPAINT LOTION

SALIPAINT LOTION is a combination of Lactic Acid and Salicylic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Alpha-hydroxy acids and Keratolytics respectively. It is used to manage skin defects such as warts, verrucae, corns and calluses. Warts and verrucae are a type of small unnecessary growths of the skin occurring on fingers, back of hands or soles and are caused by a virus and can spread to other people. Corns and calluses are hard, thick pads of skin caused by pressure and friction that occur on the feet and hands.

Lactic acid and salicylic acid in cases of corns and calluses work by softening the hardened skin growth so that it can be easily removed by using a pumice stone or emery board. It also helps manage warts and verrucae by reducing the infection and its spread to other parts of the body by killing the virus that causes them.

Before taking this medicine, tell your doctor if you are diabetic or have poor circulation to your hands or feet. SALIPAINT LOTION is not recommended for children under the age of two. The medication is relatively safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women to use. The most common side effect of applying SALIPAINT LOTION is a temporary, slight tingling sensation and tenderness at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen or last for an extended period.

Always use SALIPAINT LOTION as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply only a thin layer of this medicine to the affected area. Do not use it near flames or ignition sources (such as burning cigarettes or anything else that might ignite it), as it is inflammable and volatile. Do not apply SALIPAINT LOTION around your eyes, nose and mouth or to broken skin, cuts and grazes. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending on the type and severity of the infection.

Introduction About BURNFREE CREAM

BURNFREE CREAM is a combination of Chlorhexidine and Silver nitrate which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical antimicrobial agents. It is used in the management, management and control of infections in the condition such as minor skin burns or scalds, minor cuts injuries and scrape wounds, cracked skin. It is also used to manage, manage and control bacterial infections associated with urinary tract infections, ear infections, skin cleaning and before a surgical procedure.

Your doctor may advise you to undergo relevant medical tests to understand your existing condition. BURNFREE CREAM is not recommended for use if you are planning for a surgical procedure. It is also not advised for use in the mouth, vagina and inner ear. Consult your doctor for advice.

BURNFREE CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant women and breastfeeding mother. The possible side effects of using BURNFREE CREAM may include burning or irritating sensation of the skin, chillness, skin rashes. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects get worse.

name: PREVODINE Gargle 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About PREVODINE GARGLE

Prevodine Gargle is a germicidal gargle used for infected and inflammatory conditions of the mouth and pharynx caused by bacterial or monilial infections such as tonsilitis, pharyngitis, stomatitis, traumatic ulcers and during dental surgery. It contains povidone iodine as an active ingredient to decrease the risk of infection of the mouth by killing the micro-organisms.     

Povidone-iodine inhibits the synthesis of various cellular mechanisms of micro-organisms that lead to their death. Also, it exhibits anti-inflammatory reactions that counteracts inflammation associated with pathogens and host response.  

Always use Prevodine Gargle as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only and shake well before use. For usage and administration for children and adults, dilute with an equal volume of water and gargle or rinse thoroughly for at least 30 seconds and spit it out, do not swallow it. Repeat every two to four hours for as long as required or as directed by the doctor.

name: Wound Fix Solution 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About WOUND FIX SOLUTION

Wound Fix Solution is a super oxidized solution that is used for debridement (removal of damaged or infected tissue to enhance the healing potential of the remaining healthy tissue) and irrigation of acute and chronic wounds, ulcers, cuts, abrasion and burns. It contains hypochlorous acid and oxidized water as active ingredients that work together to heal wounds.

Hypochlorous acid is an ideal wound care agent with powerful anti-biofilm, microbicidal and wound healing properties. Oxidized water is an antiseptic solution, which is used in healing chronic wounds such as diabetic foot, infectious postoperative ulcers and burn ulcers.

Apply Wound Fix Solution directly on affected area by spraying, pouring, pressure jetting or gauze dressing. No mixing or dilution required. It is for external use only. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

name: PREVODINE Ointment 250gm
introduction:
Introduction About PREVODINE OINTMENT

Prevodine ointment is a topical antiseptic and disinfecting agent used for the management of infections in wounds and cuts. It contains Povidone Iodine as an active ingredient which is effective against bacteria including spores, fungi, yeast, protozoa, and viruses even in the presence of blood, serum, pus and necrotic tissue.

Povidone Iodine works by penetrating the cell wall of these microorganisms. It disrupts their proteins and nucleic acid structure and synthesis, resulting in killing the harmful microbes. It also controls their growth, thereby managing infections in the affected area.

Always use Prevodine ointment as advised by the physician. It is for external use only. Contact your physician if you experience any allergic reactions while using this ointment.

name: Scarab Cream 25gm
introduction:
Introduction About SCARAB CREAM

Scarab Cream is an Antiparasitic medication, used to manage scabies (skin condition where mites infest and irritate your skin) and pediculosis (lice infestation). It contains Lindane and Cetrimide as the active ingredients which is kills the disease-causing microorganisms.

Lindane (Gamma Benzene Hexachloride) exerts its parasiticidal action by being directly absorbed into the parasites and their ova. Cetrimide is an antiseptic which manages infection caused by bacteria.

Always apply Scarab Cream as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Take necessary amount of Scarab cream and apply on the affected area. Wash your hands after applying.
author: Dr. Priyanka Goel

name: PREVODINE Powder 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About PREVODINE POWDER

PREVODINE Powder is an antiseptic powder used to manage skin infections from minor cuts, wounds, scraps and burns. It contains povidone-iodine as the active ingredient.

Povidone-Iodine is an antimicrobial agent. It rapidly penetrates the cell wall of the microorganisms and disrupts their cell structure, leading to cell death. Therefore, it manages the infection from spreading further and helps in faster healing.

Use PREVODINE Powder as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Gently sprinkle the desired amount of the powder on the wound areas. Before using PREVODINE Powder consult your doctor if you have thyroid problems or any other skin conditions as a precaution.

Cipladine 7.5% Solution is a microbicidal agent used for the preparation of skin and mucus membranes, including the vagina, prior to surgery, for disinfection of wounds, emergency microbicidal management of cuts, lacerations, and abrasions, burns, post-operative dressings, and topical management of bacterial and fungal skin infections. It contains povidone-iodine as an active ingredient.

Povidone-iodine actively kills both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria, fungi, viruses, protozoa, and yeasts.

Always use Cipladine 7.5% Solution as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Used at full strength, as often as needed, as paint or wet soak, or as directed by your physician.

Introduction About PREVELON LIQUID

Prevelon Liquid is an Antiseptic and Disinfecting Agent, used as a first aid and is effective on minor cuts, bruises and wounds. It helps to heal without hurting. It contains Cetrimide and Chlorhexidine Gluconate as an active ingredient which is used as a first aid to manage from infections.

Cetrimide is a disinfectant with strong sterilizing properties. Chlorhexidine gluconate has antibacterial property which works against the microorganisms and protects against infection.

Always use Prevelon Liquid as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Dilute one part of Prevelon Liquid with three parts of clean water and apply on the wound with cotton swabs.

introduction:
Introduction About PREVODINE 7.5 SOLUTION

Prevodine Solution is a microbicidal solution used for degerming the skin pre-and-post operatively for all surgical procedures. It is for antiseptic management of superficial wounds, traumatic injuries, burns including vaginal preparation prior to a surgical procedure. Introduction About CIPLADINE OINTMENT

Cipladine Ointment is an Anti-septic ointment that is used as first aid to manage infection of cuts, scrapes, minor burns, abrasions, etc. It can also be used for pre and post-operative skin disinfection while performing wound dressings. Cipladine Ointment contains Povidone Iodine as an active ingredient which is a broad-spectrum antiseptic.

Use exactly Cipladine ointment as advised by your doctor. Cipladine ointment is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected area and apply the ointment on the affected area. Consult with your doctor if you notice any allergic reactions while using it.

Cipladine Ointment is a broad-spectrum antiseptic used to manage infection in minor cuts, wounds, scrapes, burns and infections. It is also useful for surgical wounds. It contains Povidone Iodine as an active ingredient.

introduction:
Introduction About ALBERTDINE OINTMENT

ALBERTDINE OINTMENT contains Povidone-Iodine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Broad-spectrum antiseptics. ALBERTDINE OINTMENT is used as an antiseptic for the management of minor damage or infection of the skin. It kills harmful infection-causing microorganisms.

It also helps in the management of infection in burns, lacerations, cuts, and abrasions, management of common skin infections, and infection control following circumcision, suture removal, and dressing changes, degerming care of stasis ulcers, decubitus ulcers, and the umbilical area, and in other procedures where degerming is needed.

Before using ALBERTDINE OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you have any kind of allergies, if you currently have or have ever had a thyroid problem, if you are currently having lithium therapy for depression, if your skin is broken (for example, due to a burn), or if you currently have, or have ever had, a kidney problem.

ALBERTDINE OINTMENT should be used with caution among pregnant and breastfeeding women and the elderly. ALBERTDINE OINTMENT is not recommended for use in children less than 2 years of age. The common side effects of using ALBERTDINE OINTMENT are burning, irritation, itching, and redness. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About S GEL GEL

S GEL GEL contains Nanocrystalline Silver, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimicrobials. It is used in the management of burns and wound infections. It is also used for the management of surgical cuts, leg ulcers, pressure sores, abrasions, blisters, cracked skin, minor skin cuts, and for prophylaxis of infection at the skin graft donor site.

Do not use it if you are allergic to nanocrystalline silver or any other ingredients of this medicine. There are no adequate studies on the use of S GEL GEL in pregnant women. It should be used only if clearly needed and justified by the doctor.

S GEL GEL should be used with caution in breastfeeding women, as it is not known whether this medicine passes into the human breast milk. Consult your doctor before using it. The safety and effectiveness of S GEL GEL have not been established in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of using S GEL GEL are skin necrosis, erythema multiforme, burning sensation, rashes, and interstitial nephritis. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
